name: X completes four horizontally on a standard board
input: 6 rows, 7 columns, K=4; no early win at three
test:
game = ConnectKGame(6, 7, 4)
columns = [0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 5, 3]
for turn, column in enumerate(columns):
    player = Player.X if turn % 2 == 0 else Player.O
    expected = GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS if turn == len(columns) - 1 else GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    assert game.make_move(player, column) is expected, f'Unexpected status after move {turn + 1}'

name: Rejected player and column moves do not consume a turn
input: The correct player can still make the next legal move

name: A full-column rejection leaves other columns playable
input: After two pieces fill a column, the same player retries elsewhere
test:
game = ConnectKGame(2, 3, 3)
assert game.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert game.make_move(Player.O, 0) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
try:
    game.make_move(Player.X, 0)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('Expected ValueError')
assert game.make_move(Player.X, 1) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert game.make_move(Player.O, 1) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert game.make_move(Player.X, 2) is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS

name: A board-filling winning move is a win rather than a draw

test:

columns = [0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 0]
for turn, column in enumerate(columns):
    player = Player.X if turn % 2 == 0 else Player.O
    expected = GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS if turn == len(columns) - 1 else GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    assert game.make_move(player, column) is expected, f'Unexpected status after move {turn + 1}'

name: A full board without a line is a draw and rejects further moves
input: K=3 is attainable but neither player makes three in this game

name: A win ends the game even when columns still have space
input: Neither player can continue after a normal horizontal win

name: K one wins immediately and an unreachable K can still draw
test:
game = ConnectKGame(2, 2, 1)
columns = [0]
for turn, column in enumerate(columns):
    player = Player.X if turn % 2 == 0 else Player.O
    expected = GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS if turn == len(columns) - 1 else GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    assert game.make_move(player, column) is expected, f'Unexpected status after move {turn + 1}'

game = ConnectKGame(2, 2, 3)
columns = [0, 1, 0, 1]
for turn, column in enumerate(columns):
    player = Player.X if turn % 2 == 0 else Player.O
    expected = GameStatus.DRAW if turn == len(columns) - 1 else GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    assert game.make_move(player, column) is expected, f'Unexpected status after move {turn + 1}'

name: Board dimensions and K must be positive
input: Reject zero rows, zero columns, zero K and a negative dimension

name: Separate game instances keep independent boards and turns
input: Interleaved games of different sizes must not share state
test:
first = ConnectKGame(3, 3, 3)
assert first.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
second = ConnectKGame(2, 2, 2)
assert second.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert first.make_move(Player.O, 2) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert second.make_move(Player.O, 1) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert first.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert second.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS
assert first.make_move(Player.O, 2) is GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS
assert first.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS
